nodes.title: Bañuelos–Janakiraman upper bound for the Beurling–Ahlfors transform

nodes.summary: The Beurling–Ahlfors constant is the supremum, over real numbers $p > 1$, of $\|B\|_p / (p^* - 1)$, where $B$ is the Beurling–Ahlfors transform, $\|B\|_p$ is the infimum of the real numbers $C \ge 0$ that are admissible $L^p$ bound constants for $B$ (and $0$ if there is no such $C$), and $p^* = \max(p, p/(p-1))$. The supremum is taken in $\mathbb{R}$, so it is $0$ when these ratios are not bounded above.
nodes.title: Beurling–Ahlfors constant

nodes.summary: Let $p$ and $C$ be real numbers with $C \ge 0$, and let $\|B\|_p$ be the infimum of the nonnegative admissible $L^p$ bound constants for the Beurling–Ahlfors transform $B$ ($0$ if there are none). If $C$ is an admissible $L^p$ bound constant for $B$, then $\|B\|_p \le C$.
nodes.title: Nonnegative admissible bounds bound the Beurling–Ahlfors norm

nodes.summary: For a real number $p$, the norm $\|B\|_p$ of the Beurling–Ahlfors transform $B$ is the infimum of the real numbers $C \ge 0$ that are admissible $L^p$ bound constants for $B$, and is $0$ when there is no such $C$. In particular an upper bound on $\|B\|_p$ alone does not imply that $B$ is bounded on $L^p$.
nodes.title: Norm of the Beurling–Ahlfors transform

nodes.summary: For $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ and $z \in \mathbb{C}$, $Bf(z)$ is the limit as $\varepsilon \to 0^+$ of the truncated Beurling–Ahlfors integrals $-\frac{1}{\pi} \int_{|w - z| > \varepsilon} \frac{f(w)}{(z - w)^2} \, dw$ (each taken to be $0$ when its integrand is not integrable). Where this limit does not exist, $Bf(z)$ is an unspecified complex number.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
